what: Behind the panel, 150 large circles (radius 100–300px) drift slowly (0.1–1.1px/frame), appearing and fading over 150–350 frames. Their hue is offset from the accent hue by noise (±60°) and rotates 1° per frame. The whole panel gets opacity .1 and blur 25px, so the background is softly tinted a watery color.

options.fixed: 0 means do not attach to the screen, lay it only inside the element, default 1 (fixed to screen)

note: Background fill is --kf-contrast-bg, and the circle color is around the hue of --kf-accent (saturation 60%·lightness 30%) — in the original the hue jumps to 0 (red) when it drops below 200, but that branch was left out. It runs regardless of interaction and scroll.

from.where: shared.js .t-canvas — fixed canvas behind the body on every page (z 2)
